title: A stored list view filter is AND-only: no OR group
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27386 said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` (report 6518223407, `out_of_scope_findings`). Rows 2 and 4 are taken in PR #28017.
Reach: any list view whose natural filter is an any-of, such as HotCRM's "open, or completed in the last 7 days" (#27386 row 1).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (a decision on the stored shape), then `domain:ui` (the list query build).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "list view stored filter OR group any-of ViewFilterRule" → #19751, #24129 and #20456, all closed and about other parts of the view filter, not OR groups.

## Observed
A list view's `filter` is an array of flat `ViewFilterRuleSchema` rules (`field`, `operator`, `value`) joined by AND. The `$or` grouping exists only in `FilterConditionSchema`, which the view's `filter` key does not take. So an any-of cannot be authored on a view, although the console filter builder already offers groups.

## Wanted
- **Spec:** decide the stored shape: either a filter-condition tree on views, or a group member on the rule list. Landing: `packages/spec` `ui/view.zod.ts` `ListViewSchema.filter` and `ViewFilterRuleSchema`.
- **Console:** `ui/packages/plugin-list`'s query build reads it.

Dedupe words: view filter OR group, ViewFilterRule or, list view filter any-of.

Related: #27386 (row 1).
